Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Jacopo Alighieri (author, Wikidata Q1161153), died 1348; Jarro (editor, Wikidata Q3769752), died 1915. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Alighieri, Jacopo, 1289-1348; Jarro, 1849-1915 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Chiose alla cantica dell'Inferno de Dante Alighieri, pubblicate per la prima volta in corretta lezione con riscontri e fac-simili di codici, e precedute da una indagine critica per cura di Jarro (G. Piccini), Firenze R. Bemporad, 1915, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/chioseallacantic00aliguoft. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 75%, 95%, 95% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
